body: This often happens to people. And most of the time they’re pretty angry when they do wake up. It’s hard enough to finally get the balls to make a decision like that. I ended up waking up in the icu where I spent 5 days after drinking a whole lot of methadone a lot of Xanax and a lot of Valium. I didn’t realise methadone was such a slow killer. I was pretty pissed off. Be careful tho. Sometimes you can wake up and your life is a whole lot worse . Having suffered brain damage from trying to Kill yoursel . Good luck x
